advisories.title: yaws vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Yaws did not properly sanitize XML input in its WebDAV implementation. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform XML external entity injection attacks. (CVE-2020-24379) It was discovered that Yaws mishandled certain input when running CGI scripts.

advisories.title: ruby-rack vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Andrew Lacambra discovered that Rack did not properly parse certain regular expressions. An attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass network security filters. (CVE-2026-26961) William T. Nelson discovered that Rack did not handle multipart headers correctly.

advisories.title: cakephp vulnerability
advisories.summary: Dawid Golunski discovered that CakePHP incorrectly trusted the CLIENT-IP HTTP header when determining the client IP address. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to spoof their IP address.

advisories.title: bitlbee vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that BitlBee incorrectly handled file transfer connections that expired when built with libpurple. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause BitlBee to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: apt-cacher vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Apt-Cacher did not properly handle encoded newline characters in requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform HTTP response splitting attacks.

advisories.title: libsoup2.4, libsoup3 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain WebSocket frames. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an application to crash or expose sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.10.

advisories.title: pcre2 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that PCRE2 did not correctly manage memory when processing certain patterns. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.10.

advisories.title: libmspack vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that libmspack did not properly initialize pointers when handling errors while reading KWAJ archive headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause libmspack to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: haproxy vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that HAProxy incorrectly handled truncated HTTP/2 PING frames. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause HAProxy to consume excessive CPU resources, leading to a denial of service.

advisories.title: gnome-shell vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that GNOME Shell did not properly validate icon dimensions when processing icons from a remote search provider. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause GNOME Shell to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or expose sensitive information from memory.

advisories.title: gvfs vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that GVfs did not properly validate data returned by an SFTP server. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information. (CVE-2026-84267) It was discovered that GVfs did not properly validate the size of replies from an AFP server.

advisories.title: bind9 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Bind incorrectly handled certain DNS messages with repeated singleton records such as SOA, CNAME, or DNAME records. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Bind to use excessive memory, leading to a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.10.

advisories.title: linux vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that the Bluetooth subsystem in the Linux kernel contained a use-after-free vulnerability. A local attacker could use this to cause a denial of service (system crash) or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2021-3640) Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel.

advisories.title: linux-aws vulnerability

advisories.title: dotnet8, dotnet10, dotnet11 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that the .NET Blazor WebAssembly debug proxy did not properly escape certain values. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. The fix for this CVE was originally released via USN-8942-1, but it was found to be incomplete.

advisories.title: authd vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ali Mashally discovered that authd did not properly validate user identities when matching accounts from identity providers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to gain access to another user's local account and files, resulting in unauthorized access to sensitive information.

advisories.title: brotli vulnerability
advisories.summary: USN-8956-1 fixed a vulnerability in Brotli. This update provides the corresponding fixes for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. Original advisory details: It was discovered that Brotli incorrectly handled certain compressed streams.

advisories.title: brotli vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Brotli incorrectly handled certain compressed streams. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: nginx vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that nginx incorrectly handled certain configurations using the alias directive together with rewrite rules. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause nginx to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: zlib vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ali Firas discovered that zlib incorrectly handled certain non-blocking write operations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to trigger a heap buffer overflow, resulting in a denial of service or arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: openvpn vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that OpenVPN incorrectly handled certificate subject fields. A remote authenticated user could possibly use this issue to impersonate other users.

advisories.title: python-tornado vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Tornado did not properly handle certain HTTP requests and network inputs. An attacker could possibly use these issues to cause a denial of service, expose sensitive information, or bypass access controls.

advisories.title: c-ares vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that c-ares incorrectly parsed certain SOA replies. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause c-ares to crash, resulting in a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS.

advisories.title: poppler vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that poppler incorrectly handled the password length limit when decrypting certain encrypted PDF files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.

advisories.title: ghostscript vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Rick de Jager discovered that Ghostscript incorrectly handled memory under certain circumstances when processing PostScript documents.

advisories.title: php5, php7.0, php7.2, php7.4 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: USN-8948-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. This provides the corrosponding updates in Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

advisories.title: php8.1, php8.3, php8.5 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that PHP incorrectly handled out-of-memory conditions while processing requests. A remote attacker could use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-109618) It was discovered that PHP incorrectly managed internal request state across worker reuse.

advisories.title: nss update
advisories.summary: This update removes the "emSign ECC Root CA - G3" and "Comodo AAA Services root" CA certificate due to intermediate CA certificates being compromised.

advisories.title: unbound vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Unbound incorrectly handled certain TCP connections. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Unbound to consume resources, leading to a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

advisories.title: xz-utils vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that XZ Utils incorrectly handled certain memory allocation failures when reinitializing decoders for specific compressed file formats. An attacker could possibly use this issue to trigger an invalid memory write, resulting in a denial of service or arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: ca-certificates update
advisories.summary: USN-8944-1 updated ca-certificates. This update provides the corresponding changes for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS by removing the "emSign ECC Root CA - G3" and "Comodo AAA Services root" CA certificates.

advisories.title: ca-certificates update
advisories.summary: This update removes the "emSign ECC Root CA - G3" CA certificate due to intermediate CA certificates being compromised. In addition, in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, the ca-certificates package contained outdated CA certificates.

advisories.title: protobuf vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Protocol Buffers did not properly handle negative varint lengths or enforce recursion limits when parsing input in the PHP library.

advisories.title: dotnet8, dotnet10, dotnet11 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Multiple security issues were discovered in .NET and this update includes new upstream .NET versions to fix these issues. .NET 8 has been updated to 8.0.32 in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. .NET 10 has been updated to 10.0.13 in Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10.

advisories.title: squid, squid3 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Squid incorrectly handled certain HTTP Transfer- Encoding headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to perform HTTP request smuggling attacks, bypass security mechanisms, or poison web caches.

advisories.title: libxs-parse-keyword-perl vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that the Perl XS::Parse::Keyword module did not correctly handle certain inputs. If a user or automated system were tricked into receiving specially crafted input, an attacker could cause a denial of service.

advisories.title: libxtst vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that libXtst did not properly handle certain RECORD replies from the X server. A malicious X server could possibly use this issue to cause libXtst clients to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

advisories.title: cifs-utils vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that cifs-utils incorrectly handled credentials files used by privileged mount.cifs invocations. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary mount options into a privileged mount, resulting in a privilege escalation.

advisories.title: openssh, openssh-gssapi vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that OpenSSH's sftp client incorrectly handled paths returned by the server during a recursive copy operation. A remote attacker controlling the server could possibly use this issue to write files to unintended locations.

advisories.title: php8.5, php8.3, php8.1, php7.4, php7.2, php7.0, php5 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that PHP did not properly validate the size of MySQL server packets in the mysqlnd driver. A malicious server could possibly use this issue to cause PHP to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

advisories.title: golang-1.22 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Go did not enforce a maximum recursion depth when parsing deeply nested ASN.1 structures. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Go to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

advisories.title: pyjwt vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Kingsley Olukanni discovered that PyJWT did not properly handle unknown key identifiers when retrieving signing keys. An attacker could possibly use this issue to amplify requests to the configured key endpoint, resulting in a denial of service.

advisories.title: rabbitmq-server vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that RabbitMQ Server incorrectly handled CORS wildcard origin configuration. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a cross-site request forgery attack.

advisories.title: curl vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Stanislav Fort discovered that curl did not properly clear AWS SigV4 authentication state when CURLOPT_AWS_SIGV4 was set to NULL. An attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.

advisories.title: linux-oem-7.0 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that the Linux kernel did not properly handle shared page fragments during socket buffer operations, collectively known as Dirty Frag. A logic flaw existed in the XFRM ESP-in-TCP subsystem and in the RxRPC networking subsystem when processing paged fragments.

advisories.title: linux-raspi vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that some AMD processors did not properly clear data in the floating point divider unit during speculative execution. A local attacker could use this to expose sensitive information. (CVE-2025-54505) Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel.

advisories.title: curl regression
advisories.summary: USN-8487-1 fixed vulnerabilities in curl. Unfortunately that update contained an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-8927. This update fixes the problem.

advisories.title: curl vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Andrew Nesbitt discovered that curl could reuse an existing live connection during STARTTLS-based connection upgrades even when the TLS configuration did not match. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause curl to use an unintended TLS configuration.

advisories.title: libssh2 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that libssh2 incorrectly handled the sftp_symlink() function. A malicious SSH server or machine-in-the-middle attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service.

advisories.title: libyang vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that libyang incorrectly handled certain metadata list pointers. An attacker could use this issue to cause libyang to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: libgd-perl vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that GD.pm incorrectly handled filename arguments. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary commands or overwrite files.

advisories.title: hplip vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that HPLIP incorrectly handled certain print data. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause HPLIP to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-8631) It was discovered that HPLIP incorrectly handled certain inputs.

advisories.title: roundcube vulnerability
advisories.summary: It was discovered that Roundcube Webmail was prone to a Cross-Site-Scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document. An attacker could use this issue to execute arbitrary web script in the context of an affected user's session.

advisories.title: nss vulnerability
advisories.summary: Haruto Kimura discovered that NSS had incorrecty handled parsing PKCS#11 URI escape sequences. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause NSS to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or obtain sensitive information.

advisories.title: sqlite3 vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that SQLite incorrectly handled certain memory operations in the FTS5 full-text search extension. An attacker could use this issue to cause SQLite to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: libheif vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: It was discovered that libheif incorrectly handled certain crafted HEIF files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-47178) It was discovered that libheif incorrectly validated offsets when decoding certain crafted HEIF files.
